description: This file defines the MessageCommand interface used for sending messages to things and features within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes method signatures, default implementations, constants for message routing, and nested classes defining JSON schema fields.

classes.name: MessageCommand
classes.description: A generic interface for commands to send messages to things or features, parametrized by message payload type and command type.

classes.name: MessageCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains definitions for JSON fields used in serializing and deserializing MessageCommand instances.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the Message object to be delivered.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Provides the type prefix for the command, default implementation.

methods.name: getMessageType
methods.description: Returns the message type, typically used as routing key in messaging transport.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Gets the ThingId associated with this command.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string, here 'message'.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Builds the JSON pointer path to the message resource based on message direction and subject.
